healthcheck.name: Release tooling is present
healthcheck.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import sys; ok = Path('plugins/craftflow/scripts/craftflow_version_bump.py').exists() and Path('plugins/craftflow/scripts/craftflow_version_consistency_check.py').exists(); print('ok' if ok else 'missing'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

scenarios.name: Version consistency gate passes against the live tree
scenarios.given: All 6 version-bearing files are at the same version

scenarios.name: Version bump classifier and writer tests pass
scenarios.given: The pure classifier, semver arithmetic, and 10-field writers are implemented
scenarios.then: Every case including properties P1, P2, P3, P6 passes

scenarios.name: Version consistency evaluator tests pass
scenarios.given: evaluate_consistency is pure and collects all errors
scenarios.then: All 20 cases including the drift and empty-expect-version negatives pass

scenarios.name: Baseline subtree split determinism holds
scenarios.given: The craftflow-v1.0.0 baseline tag exists locally
scenarios.when: git subtree split runs against that tag
scenarios.then: It reproduces the historical published head exactly, which is what makes every push to craftflow-public a fast-forward
scenarios.expected: Exits 0 (takes ~75s; measured 1m11s on a cold clone)
